description:
A new server room has been installed in the Middle Floor Core zone (M.C25) of the 4StoreyBuilding. The current building-wide cooling schedule includes a night setback (allowing temperatures to rise to 85F+ after 6 PM), causing the servers to overheat at night. 

Your task is to create a dedicated 24/7 cooling schedule for this specific zone:
1. Create a new Day Schedule with a constant 72F cooling setpoint for all 24 hours.
2. Create the necessary Week and Annual Schedules to apply this daily profile year-round.
3. Assign this new schedule to the 'Middle Floor Core' zone (M.C25) as the COOL-TEMP-SCH.
4. CRITICAL: Ensure that the other zones in the building (like M.S21) are NOT affected and continue to use the original night-setback schedule.
5. Run the annual simulation and save the project.

The 4StoreyBuilding.inp project is pre-loaded. You must navigate the Detailed Interface to the Schedules and Air-Side HVAC/Building Shell sections.
